cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

mechanism: Treat a partner's text-only reconciliation as a former pupil's incomplete manners exercise, shaping a real spoken apology before a family visit.
confusable: Not naming the wrong or offering detached coaching: A should correct the means of showing remorse while needing reconciliation now.
comparison: Public visit pressure and digital evasion rather than a private tea ritual.
seedUse: Retains parents arriving, thumbs-up/sad face and I-sentence demand; replaces stock training prefaces with a specific claimed lesson.
